name: Four Seasons Hotel Megeve
insider_take: Nestled in the heart of the French Alps, this Four Seasons property sits at 3,280 feet elevation where Olympic skiing history was made and Alpine luxury reaches new heights.
whats_special: Built on the site of the original 1928 Winter Olympics venue, the hotel offers direct access to the Evasion Mont-Blanc ski area with 445 kilometers of pristine slopes. The property features authentic Savoyard architecture using local stone and timber, while the spa incorporates natural Alpine spring water treatments that have been used for healing since Roman times.
pro_tip: Book the Haute Route helicopter experience directly through the concierge - it's the only way to access untouched powder runs on the Vallée Blanche glacier that most visitors never see.
dont_miss: The hotel's rooftop infinity pool heated to 98°F year-round offers unobstructed views of Mont Blanc's north face. Visit the underground wine cellar housing over 15,000 bottles, including rare vintages from local Savoie vineyards that predate the resort town itself.
pros: Prime ski-in/ski-out location in prestigious Megève resort
Exceptional Four Seasons luxury service and amenities
Stunning Alpine mountain views and authentic French charm
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects exclusive resort location
Seasonal availability primarily during ski season
